column1: # bluetooth components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# A header row shows the controller; rows are "address<TAB>name<TAB>display".
mode    paired      -       paired devices, connected first                                    default
mode    all         -       every device bluez knows, the ones a scan found included           -
action  connect     alt-c   connect (the output stays on a failure)                            foreground,reload
action  pair        alt-p   pair, trust and connect (asks for a PIN when the device wants one)  foreground,reload
action  trust       alt-t   trust or untrust (each device flips)                               notify,reload
action  remove      alt-x   remove: unpair and forget                                          foreground,confirm,reload
action  scan        alt-s   all: scan for FZX_BLUETOOTH_SCAN_SECONDS, then list what was found  foreground,reload
action  power       alt-P   power the controller on or off                                     notify,reload
action  copy        ctrl-y  copy the addresses                                                 silent,builtin
